lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters situated posterior to the gill slits, displaying a semi-regular grid-like spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a structural grid pattern most visible in the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal ridge runs along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient where the dorsal side is lighter than the ventral shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6 discrete white spots, primarily concentrated in the central and basal regions of the fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct radiating spot pattern on the dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin; two remoras are attached to the ventral-lateral flank.
